blocks.content: Course: HTML Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
We'll build the page in this order:

items: Set up the HTML document structure
Add the main layout of the page
Decide and list the major blog sections
Start with real headings and real paragraphs

blocks.content: Each step is important and cannot be skipped. Proper planning in the initial stages saves you a lot of headaches in the future.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
